text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
They've passed the 600-meter mark!!
The critical moment is here! Who will make their move?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(So strong...!! So these are Senior Class Uma Musume—
those standing on the front lines...!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Even so――――even so...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Win and connect!! Carve it open!!
Our future!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Win!! I'll definitely win!!!
Win!! Win!!! WIN!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna wiiiiiiiiiin!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —It's a bubble economy!!! It's the bubble!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Bubble Gum Fellow!!!
Bubble Gum Fellow crosses the finish line!!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I did it…………――――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I did it…… I did it……!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I wonnnnnn!!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Seriouslyyy!! This is a historic moment!!!
Bubble just smashed the generation barrier!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaa~!!
I've got total goosebumps...!
Wait, did an era just change before our eyes?!"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
I did it…… I did it, I DID ITTTTT!!
Did you see that!? Cure-chan, did you see that just now!?!?
Bubble-chan WONNNNNNN!!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
I saw it!! I was right next to you the whole time!!
Still, you really did it, Bubble...!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Bubble Gum Fellow has done it!
Victory in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) by a Classic-class Umamusume!
A historic achievement has been made!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"And there it is! Following in Waltz of Shadow's footsteps, another victory for the Heavenly Kings!!
Carrying on the momentum from her best friend!!"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Bubble... thank you...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaann!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: We did it we did it—!!!

"...Even I don't know
whether I'm crying or laughing."

"We were so overjoyed that...
clasping hands with Bubble Gum Fellow,
we cheered and jumped up and down on the spot—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Today, we truly proved
one form of strength."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And... by carrying on what was entrusted to me by Waltz, I was able to open up this view before us.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that's only one win.
So—
choice_data_list: Yeah. This is where a new start begins...!
Yeah. This is a brand new start...!

text_block_list.text: "To solidify this proof of strength gained today... and ensure the momentum carried over from my dear friend doesn't end here—"

Bubble Gum Fellow and I must push forward from here.
Aiming for new heights...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —As expected of you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's carve it out together.
To heights that will make our strength, the name of the 'Four Heavenly Queens,'
echo across the racing world...!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)
—Cheers erupt all around Bubble Gum Fellow, who has achieved a historic feat.

It was certainly there.
A brand-new brilliance, distinct from the Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-chan!!
Congratulations, seriouslyyy!!
You were so, so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for letting me witness a race that changed history.
You did great out there."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I should be the one thanking you all for your support.
It's all thanks to you that I was able to win today...!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Waltz wants to thank Bubble in person too.
...Here, I've got her on the line.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: "......Bubble."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations.
That was a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you! It's all thanks to
Waltz winning the Kikuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: "Hearing you say that... makes me truly happy—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
“......Um, you know...
...The promise, from that time—”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: “—Still, my role isn't over yet.”

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's a first in history, it's still just one win.
I've only thrown a stone into the pond...
My reputation isn't set in stone yet.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'll keep winning from here on out.
—Starting with the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I intend to win, and prove
that our strength is undeniably real.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds nice, doesn't it, Trainer?

—Held at Tokyo Racecourse,
the Japan Cup is an international GⅠ race over 2,400 meters of turf,
bringing together top contenders from all over the world.

"Winning here will cement the status
of Bubble Gum Fellow, who emerged from today's victory
as the nation's strongest middle-distance runner."

There is very little time between today and race day,
making for a grueling schedule.
However, there is no better race for our next objective—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Wait for me, Waltz.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: With what you've entrusted to me, I'll carve out an even brighter future... I swear it...!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"‘...I'll be watching.
Your next battle, that is.’"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
—I-it'll be incredible!
If Bubble-chan goes on to win
the Japan Cup too...!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If that happens, the center of the racing world
will undoubtedly be Bubble...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't let it end with just me.
I'll declare to the world that all of the "Four Heavenly Kings" are like this...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So Lapis and Cure, look forward to it.
To my victory in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Lapis & Cure
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Ah...!
...And so, Bubble Gum Fellow's next goal greatly raised the expectations of his peers.
Afterward, once we made it back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like everyone was
a little brighter today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...If so, I'd be so happy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Still—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't been able to shake away
the sadness and frustration from everyone
about Waltz not being able to run anymore...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
More, even more...
I have to show them even more than today...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Me...! The "Four Heavenly Kings"...! That strength...!!
choice_data_list: ――You can't try to do it all on your own
――You can't try to do it all on your own, okay?

text_block_list.text:
The feelings for her friends that continue
to burn brightly inside Bubble Gum Fellow.

"Knowing full well how strong a bond that came from...
I felt that she shouldn't have to carry it all alone."
choice_data_list: Let's fight together and prove it...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“......Thank you.
That's really reassuring.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, starting tomorrow...
let's fight together toward the world again."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(My body feels so heavy, as expected...
Though that's only natural after a race like that—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Still... I have to do it—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(I will win. Absolutely.
For everyone's sake...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (............What was that just now—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Just my imagination, huh.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (...I should rest early today. Starting tomorrow, we prepare immediately for the Japan Cup.)

...To further prove their strength
and stir up an even greater whirlwind for the "Four Heavenly Kings,"
the path continues toward the Japan Cup.

In that very moment, a tiny, faint...
sound of something popping echoed out, unnoticed by anyone—
